paragraph: The bounded image/authority comparison **returns-to** [the complete Hypostasis telling](../../mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/hypostasis-archons-norea-sophia/WHOLE.md#27-eleleth--rescue--revelation-of-the-root). The rulers model a human from a reflected image, yet cannot originate the life they seek to possess. Norea refuses their asserted descent; Eleleth answers her inquiry by disclosing their genesis and her root. Sabaoth’s changed allegiance and the promised future liberation remain distinct from her immediate rescue. This is a retrieval and comparison route, **human-amplified: no** for the proposed Hybris, Māyā, evaluator and psychological appointments. The tractate’s soteriology retains its difference from the native account of manifestation.
